Ava (People Ops): Thanks for the great questions at today's all-hands. Using this thread for follow-ups on promotions, leveling, comp, and benefits. Quick bullets: calibration starts next week, comp letters mid-June, bonuses in July.
Sophie L.: Can we get the concrete L3->L4 checklist? Looking for examples to work toward.
Raj (VP Eng): L4 expectations: owns multi-team feature, measurable product impact, mentors peers. We'll surface 3 concrete examples per track.
Marcus (CTO): Engineers: think shipping a cross-service rollout, owning reliability improvements, or leading a migration.
Tariq: If I'm promoted, when does the salary change take effect? Next paycheck?
Jules (Recruiting): Promotion effective date = salary change date. Payroll cutoff is the 20th; if promo effective before cutoff you'll see it on next pay, otherwise following pay.
Nina: Is there an appeals process if calibration misses context?
Ava (People Ops): Yes. There will be a 72-hour appeal window after notifications. Send a short doc to people-ops@redwood.com with evidence and your manager's note.
Elena (CEO): Appeals are for missing facts/context, not for re-arguing the rubric. Keep it concise.
oncall-bot: Reminder: calibration meeting 2026-06-09 09:00-11:00 PT.
Sophie L.: Will promotions be announced publicly? I'd prefer private first.
Elena (CEO): Private notification first. Public shoutouts in #all-hands the following week, unless the person requests delay.
Marcus (CTO): We'll post the leveling rubric draft Tuesday with team-specific examples.
Ava (People Ops): We'll compile an FAQ and post in #docs/people-ops. DM if you need confidentiality. Thread open 48 hours for follow-ups. Thanks!
